name: MT-7716
summary: MT-7716 is an experimental opioid drug that could potentially be used in the treatment of alcohol addiction.

pharmacology.text: Unlike most opioids, MT-7716 does not appear to act through delta, kappa and mu opioid receptors, but instead is an agonist of the nociceptin receptor.
